# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 21 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QHa (Cave 1), Col. 21 | **Condition:** better preserved

---

**21:1** [...] Blessed are You, O God of-mercies, who established the-works-of [...] by Your wisdom.

**21:2** [...] By Your wisdom You have fashioned all these things, and before any being was created [...]

**21:3** [...] You appointed all their works before ever they existed, and the-utterance-of Your mouth [...]

**21:4** [...] Without You nothing has been done, and nothing has been known apart-from Your will.

**21:5** You, You alone have created the-righteous-one and from the-womb You established him for the-appointed-time-of favor,

**21:6** to be guarded in Your covenant and to walk in all of it, and to pour-out upon him the-abundance-of Your mercies,

**21:7** and to open all the-distress-of his soul to eternal salvation and perpetual peace without lack.

**21:8** And You have raised his glory above the-flesh. But the-wicked You created for [the-time]-of Your wrath,

**21:9** and from the-womb You consecrated them for the-day-of slaughter.

**21:10** For they walked in a way that is not good, and they rejected Your covenant,

**21:11** and their soul loathed Your statutes, and they did not delight in all that You commanded,

**21:12** and they chose that which You hate. For according-to the-mysteries-of Your understanding

**21:13** You have established all these things to make-known Your glory. But what is a spirit-of flesh

**21:14** to understand all these things, and to have-insight into the-counsel-of Your great wonder?

**21:15** What is one-born-of woman among all Your terrible works?

**21:16** He is a construction-of dust, kneaded with water; guilt-of transgression is his foundation,

**21:17** shameful nakedness and a source-of impurity, and a spirit-of crookedness rules over him.

**21:18** If he acts-wickedly, he shall become a sign for eternity and a portent for generations,

**21:19** [...] For You have founded all things before You created them, and You knew all their deeds for-all generations,

**21:20** [...] and without You nothing is done, and nothing is known apart-from Your will.

**21:21** You have formed every spirit, and You have established the-appointed-duty and the-judgment for-all their deeds.

**21:22** You stretched-out the-heavens for Your glory; all [their host] You have established according-to Your will,

**21:23** and the-mighty winds according-to their laws, before they became angels-of holiness,

**21:24** [...] and the-eternal luminaries according-to their mysteries, and the-stars according-to their paths,

**21:25** [...] clouds and rain and lightning with their purpose, and the-storehouses-of snow and hail

**21:26** [...] with their appointed-seasons, and the-footsteps-of [...] with their tasks,

**21:27** [...] and the-treasuries-of [...] according-to their purposes, and Sheol and Abaddon [...]

**21:28** [...] You have fashioned the-earth by Your strength, the-seas and the-deeps [...]

**21:29** [...] You have established by Your wisdom all that is in them, and all their produce [...]

**21:30** For without You nothing is done, and nothing is known apart-from Your will.

**21:31** There is none beside You, and none to stand-against Your strength,

**21:32** and nothing compares to Your glory, and to Your might there is no price.

**21:33** Who among all Your great and wonderful creatures can retain strength to stand before Your glory?

**21:34** And what then is he, the-one-who-returns-to his dust, that he should prevail? For Your glory alone [...]

---

*EMET notes: Column 21 is one of the better-preserved later columns of 1QHa. Construct chains hyphenated to reflect Hebrew bound forms. "Spirit-of flesh" (ruach basar) preserved literally as characteristic Hodayot anthropology. Lacunae indicated with [...] only where physical manuscript damage prevents reading. Line numbering follows Sukenik/Stegemann reconstruction.*
